SERVER_PORT_DOC: Port for the intercom web interface and WebSocket stream. Open http://<volumio-ip>:<port> on your phone. Requires plugin restart to take effect.
INTERCOM_GAIN_DOC: Volume multiplier applied to the incoming audio (0.1 – 5.0). 1.0 = unity gain. Increase if your phone microphone is too quiet.
AUTO_RESUME_DOC: Automatically resume Volumio playback when the broadcast ends. Works best with local library and MPD sources.
SAMPLE_RATE_DOC: Audio sample rate for the broadcast stream. 16000 Hz is recommended for voice. Higher rates use more bandwidth but improve audio quality.
